name: Ráksi (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Ráksi: a quartered red and blue shield with crossed keys, a lion, a crayfish and a sheaf of grain, inscribed RÁKSI on a scroll.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
